agents.name: Claude Code
agents.environment: Claude Code CLI on Linux, macOS, or Windows
agents.hook_mapping: SessionStart → recall, Stop → checkpoint reminder, PreCompact → pending marker
agents.limitations: Install the marketplace plugin or the manual hooks, never both. The native CLI must be available on PATH and hooks remain fail-open.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex
agents.environment: Codex CLI or desktop with local command execution
agents.hook_mapping: SessionStart → recall, Stop → checkpoint reminder, PreCompact → pending marker
agents.limitations: The user must review and trust the hooks. Command hooks do not run in Work Cloud without local execution.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.verified_version: Cursor 1.7+ official hooks contract + adapter tests
agents.environment: Cursor desktop or CLI with local command hooks and Python 3
agents.hook_mapping: sessionStart → recall, stop → one bounded checkpoint follow-up, preCompact → pending marker
agents.limitations: Cursor uses its own lowercase events and response schema, so the translation adapter is required. stop loop_limit stays at 1; preCompact is observation-only.

agents.name: Muse Code
agents.verified_version: Muse Code 1.3.0 official hook contract + manifest tests
agents.environment: Muse Code terminal or CI on Linux, macOS, or Windows
agents.hook_mapping: SessionStart → recall, Stop → checkpoint reminder, PreCompact → pending marker
agents.limitations: Project hooks run only after workspace trust. Muse Code has no per-hook trust command; restart a session after edits and inspect startup diagnostics.

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.minimum_version: 0.22.5 verified floor; earlier hook release not established
agents.verified_version: Hermes Agent 0.22.5 official contract + adapter tests
agents.environment: Hermes CLI, Gateway, Desktop, TUI, or dashboard chat
agents.hook_mapping: pre_llm_call → recall/next-turn checkpoint, pre_verify → coding checkpoint, post_compaction → pending marker
agents.limitations: Shell hooks require first-use consent. Non-coding final turns may checkpoint on the next prompt because on_session_end is observation-only.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.verified_version: OpenClaw 2026.10.9 isolated runtime load + adapter tests
agents.environment: OpenClaw Gateway with native plugins enabled
agents.hook_mapping: before_prompt_build → recall, before_agent_finalize → checkpoint revision, before_compaction → pending marker
agents.limitations: Conversation access and prompt injection must be explicitly allowed. A harness that does not emit before_agent_finalize cannot force the checkpoint pass.
